srs.description: The Spatial Reference System URI (e.g., http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/OGC/1.3/CRS84) that defines the coordinate system.

name.description: Human-readable name for this location (e.g. 'Golden Gate Park', 'San Francisco Bay Area')

location.description: The location of where the work was performed as a URI, blob, or inline string.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

lpVersion.description: The version of the Location Protocol

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.

description.description: Additional context about this location, such as its significance to the work or specific boundaries

locationType.description: An identifier for the format of the location data. Use `geojson-point` for a single GeoJSON Point; use `geojson` as the catch-all for any other GeoJSON geometry (Polygon, MultiPolygon, FeatureCollection, etc.) — the inner payload's own GeoJSON `type` field carries the specifics. Values beyond the known set are permitted; see the Location Protocol spec for the canonical registry: https://spec.decentralizedgeo.org/specification/location-types/#location-type-registry

string.description: A location represented as a string, e.g. coordinates or a small GeoJSON string.
